name: search_product
description: Search the catalogue by product name (Arabic, English, brand) or active ingredient. Use this before any stock/order/hold action. Returns candidates and, for a brand, alternatives (other brands with the same active ingredient). If a brand is not found, call it again with active_ingredient set to that brand's generic active ingredient.

query.description: Customer's term for the product: Arabic name, English name, brand, or ingredient. e.g. 'بنادول', 'panadol', 'paracetamol'.

branch_id.description: Optional. Restrict results to products stocked at this branch.

active_ingredient.description: Optional. Generic active ingredient (e.g. 'amoxicillin', 'paracetamol') to find the same medicine under any brand - use when the customer's brand is not found.

returns.description: candidates: list of {product_id, name_ar, name_en, brand, scientific_name, price_sar, match, requires_prescription, prescription_on_file}; alternatives: same active ingredient, other brands; active_ingredient; note (e.g. requested strength not available); hint when nothing matched. Lists may be empty.
